notes.title: Additional Languages Update
notes.notes: With the latest game update, text support has been added for Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Russian, and Turkish languages!

notes.title: Persona 5 Tactica Patch Notes 1.0.3
notes.notes:
We have released a patch for Persona 5 Tactica. The fixes are as follows:
[list]
[*] Performance and stability improvements
[*] Fixes to mechanics during battle
[*] Fixes to conversation events
[*] Various other miscellaneous fixes
[/list]
The patch will be applied automatically when you start the game.

Thank you for your support of Persona 5 Tactica!

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/17/2023
notes.notes:
We have released a patch for Persona 5 Tactica, that was released on November 17, 2023. The fixes are as follows:
[list]
[*] Optimized performance and stability. 
[*] Fixed battle behavior. 
[*] Fixed some conversation cutscenes. 
[*] Fixed other minor bugs. 
[/list]The patch will be applied automatically when you start the game.

Thank you for your support of Persona 5 Tactica!
